svg.title: From more roots to less total work
svg.desc: A change in relation yield must be evaluated together with verification, recombination, rank and matrix costs.
svg.text: From more roots to less total work
A change in relation yield must be evaluated together with verification, recombination, rank and matrix costs.
Use measured operation costs on the same target subgroup and factor-base setup before comparing methods.
pvalid = probability of a verified relation per trial.
η = effective information yield per verified relation.
Assume pvalid,η>0; rates may change during collection.
Schematic Krylov scale after filtering to r≈s.
cₙ is modular-arithmetic cost; w̄ is average row weight.
ILLUSTRATIVE MODEL · NOT CHALLENGE ATTACK MEASUREMENTS
Collection cost per effective row, in normalized work units
Alternative B: 2.00× the baseline collection cost per effective row.
The collection formula is a diagnostic model, not a theorem. Matrix filtering can change dimensions and row weight; include every phase in total work.
